snippet.title: Marble's Marbles - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Marble's Marbles, a stylized action arcade game developed by James Oliver. Players will aid Marble's quest to find all of his lost marbles through a diverse set of levels with physics-based challenges to overcome. Marble's Marbles is coming soon to PC (Steam).
